Name: Pink Cherry Trees
Author: PashaWithHat
Description:
Now compatible with recolors (and 1.6)! If you use DaisyNiko's[color=#f4cccc] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255][color=#f4cccc]Earthy[/color][/url][/color], Eemie's [color=#f4cccc][url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/580620-eemies-just-a-new-map-recolour-content-patcher-edition][color=#f4cccc]Just A New Map[/color][/url][/color], Hesper's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4966][color=#f4cccc]Foliage Redone[/color][/url], Lita's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869][color=#f4cccc]Starblue Valley[/color][/url], grapeponta's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367][color=#f4cccc]Vibrant Pastoral[/color][/url], or Acerbicon's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2995][color=#f4cccc]Wittily Named Recolor[/color][/url], your indoor cherry trees will match your color scheme. Use a different recolor? Let me know and I'll add it!

🌸🌸🌸

Ever wished the cherry trees you planted in your greenhouse were pink like they are outside during spring? Now they are!

Note: if you're using a recolor mod that changes the fruitTrees.png file, you may need to disable that mod's fruit tree alteration. There's usually an option in those mods' configuration settings (config.json file).

Inspired by u/Commercial-Title55 on Reddit.
